data.name: Khaluq
data.gender_notes: Khaluq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘kh-l-q’ which means 'to create' or 'to shape'. In Islamic context, it refers to Allah's creation of the universe and all beings. The name Khaluq carries the meaning “Created, Shaped” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaluq usually hope their child will grow to embody created, shaped and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of Allah's divine power and creativity.
data.etymology: Khaluq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Created, Shaped.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaluq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Khaluq
in_english.meaning: A name of Allah, the creator, the one who produces
in_english.long_meaning: Khaluq is a name of Allah mentioned in the Quran. It is derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-q' which means to create or produce. Khaluq signifies the creator of all things, the one who brings into existence. In Islamic tradition, this name holds great significance and is often used to refer to Allah. It reflects the attribute of Allah as the sole creator and originator of all beings.
